class.name: PXArchiveTerrain
class.brief_description: Displays Phoenix terrain archive tiles around the active camera.
class.description: Loads terrain tiles from PX archive data near the current camera and attaches completed tiles to the scene.

method.name: refresh_visible_tiles
method.description: Requests a refresh for terrain tiles around the current camera.

members.member: Root folder that contains the archived terrain data.
Latitude represented by the scene origin.
Longitude represented by the scene origin.
Altitude represented by the scene origin.
Terrain detail level. Higher values show finer terrain and cost more work.
Texture detail level. Higher values show clearer textures and cost more work.
Compatibility value that also updates the maximum background tile jobs per refresh.
Maximum number of tile load jobs scheduled by one refresh.
Maximum number of loaded tiles attached to the scene in one frame.
Maximum number of vertices read from one tile.
Number of extra archive rings opened around the camera archive.
Vertical margin used when deciding whether a tile is near the camera view.
Distance around the camera where tiles are allowed to load.
Multiplier that decides how far displayed tiles can be from the loading range before they are cleared.
Maximum frame time spent attaching newly loaded tiles to the scene.
Time between camera checks for loading new terrain.
Camera movement distance needed before a refresh is requested.
Camera rotation angle needed before a refresh is requested.
Number of background threads used for tile loading.
